notes.title: Full version released - Left early access version
notes.notes:
The final version of the game is released now.

It contains more two levels.

Enjoy it.

notes.title: Game is about to left Early Access
notes.notes:
Thugs Law is about to left the Early Access version.
The final release is coming.
Two more levels will be available and two new achievements.

notes.title: 2 issues fixed - Level select and quit game
notes.notes:
Level 9 and 10 are showing correctly on the level select screen
Quit on the pause menu is working properly now.

notes.title: New language available - Brazilian Portuguese
notes.notes:
The game is now multi-language.
English and Brazilian Portuguese languages are available now.

notes.title: Thugs Law is released on Steam
notes.notes:
I release my new game on Steam, Thugs Law is a third person game when you control a citizen that fights against bad guys using different weapons.
When you take your gun, don't forget to aim your enemies head. It will be easier if you crouch to move slowly behind them.
